subject: Tenant CAIQ evidence pipeline and sampling cadence
messages:
From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake: tenant evidence pipeline and sampling cadence

Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting the CSA/CAIQ intake for our vendor security review and need a tenant-scoped evidence plan from Redwood that shows: the control-to-artifact mapping (for tenant isolation, key management, telemetry), the sampling cadence for runtime logs and KV-cache artifacts, and how you intend to deliver packaged evidence for our audit window.

Can you share a proposed pipeline (who will stage artifacts, expected retention slices, and the frequency of sampling) and an initial set of artifacts we should expect to receive? We attach the Greenline CAIQ template to show the fields we'll ingest.

Attachments: greenline_caiq_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Tom Erickson
Director, Vendor Assurance
Greenline Health

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: tenant evidence pipeline and sampling cadence

Tom —

Appreciate the template and the clear ask. High-level proposal below; attaching a quick scope matrix so we can iterate.

Summary proposal
- Ownership: Marissa will own evidence ingestion and packaging; Jonas will own runtime/telemetry samples and technical mapping. I will be your CAIQ PM and primary contact.
- Delivery cadence: weekly artifact bundles for initial sprint (2 weeks), then bi-weekly sampling for runtime logs; monthly bundle for static artifacts (key rotation records, policy attestations).
- Sampling approach: for telemetry we propose deterministic sampling windows (three 10-minute windows per day across representative shards) + on-demand replays for specific queries.
- Retention slices: tenant-level runtime logs (90 days hot, 1 year cold), telemetry traces (30 days), config snapshots (12 months).

Next steps
1) Marissa will set up a secure evidence bucket and share ingest instructions.
2) We'll map each CAIQ question to an owner and artifact type.
3) Schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with your audits team.

Attachments: kimberly_scope_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Kimberly / Marissa —

Thanks — I sketched the technical mapping and flagged the controls that require runtime proof (CSA: INF-10 / IAM-2 / TEC-5 equivalents). Key notes:
- Runtime logs: we'll extract per-tenant session traces from the inference gateway and rotate into a staging bucket. I propose three sample windows per day (00:00-00:10 UTC, 08:00-08:10 UTC, 16:00-16:10 UTC) to capture global traffic patterns.
- KV cache evidence: snapshot of tenant namespaces with hash-only keys + proof-of-eviction trace. We'll avoid PII in artifacts; where needed we'll provide redacted logs and signed attestations.
- Keystore: HSM audit trails can be exported as a signed CSV; note that for customer-managed keys we can provide attestations rather than raw key material.
- Automation: I'll add mapping to the scope matrix and propose a small Lambda job to assemble the bundle and generate a manifest.json (manifest will be a list — we can convert to your ingest schema).

Attachments referenced: runtime_log_sample_2025-07-15.log (log)

Jonas Weber
Principal Engineer, Platform Observability
Redwood Inference
